## Known biases

Events are what the National Weather Service office for a county chose to enter, from spotters, public, media, officials and gauges; reporting depends on population, observers and office practice, so a flash flood entry means somebody reported it, and no entry means only that nobody did. Damage fields are estimates and are often 0.00K.
